venue_name: <venue as signed on site, e.g. Main Building, Hall B>
floor_label: <floor as the venue names it; must be the --floor of the run>

capture.settings: <resolution, frame rate, exposure/focus lock, stabilisation, lens (wide/main)>
capture.orientation: <landscape/portrait; whether the device recorded gravity (it usually does not into the file)>

unavailable_sensors: <e.g. imu, depth, gps: what the media do NOT carry>
notes: <lighting, moving people or objects, glass, mirrors, anything that may hurt reconstruction>
